name: Cache Metrics
description: Records cache hits/misses and cache-tag invalidations and sends them to New Relic as custom events.
project_description: Cache Metrics records Drupal cache activity as time-series telemetry so you can measure cache performance in production. It decorates the cache_factory service to log every cache get (hit/miss) per bin, and registers a cache_tags_invalidator service to log every cache-tag invalidation. Events are emitted to New Relic as custom events (CacheGet and InvalidateTag) via the New Relic PHP extension, and are meant to be visualized and analyzed with New Relic Insights (NRQL). It has no admin UI, routes, or config entities; behavior is tuned entirely with container parameters in a services.yml file. Both the factory decorator and the invalidator are designed to be overridden so an alternative analytics provider can be used instead of New Relic.
